I provide appropriate guidance and support based on their individual needs and assure them that their concerns will be treated with care and confidentiality.

Students are motivated to communicate their problems without hesitation, and necessary remedial measures are initiated as soon as possible in coordination with the concerned authorities. This mentoring approach helps create a supportive environment that promotes students' academic progress, well-being, confidence, and overall development.

5.	Placement Training: Monitored students’ participation and progress in placement training programmes.
6.	Placement and Career Guidance: Provided guidance regarding placement preparation, career opportunities and skill requirements.
7.	Scholarship Support: Shared information about available scholarships and guided eligible students in the application and document-submission process.
8.	Support for Academically Weak Students: Identified students requiring academic support and provided counselling, guidance and regular follow-up.
9.	Online Certification Courses: Encouraged students to enrol in and complete NPTEL/SWAYAM and other relevant certification courses.
10.	Internship Guidance: Guided students in identifying and applying for suitable internship opportunities.
11.	Technical and Skill Development: Encouraged students to participate in technical events, workshops, hackathons and skill-development programmes.
12.	Individual Mentoring and Follow-up: Addressed individual academic and administrative concerns and coordinated with the concerned faculty members/departments whenever required.
